golangci.description: fails when golangci-lint reports findings on anchored Go files; dep-gated on the golangci-lint binary; config is the repo's committed .golangci.yml (differential: findings on changed lines only); the run covers the packages of Go files changed against the merge-base with main

forbid-call.description: fails when any anchored file calls <pkg>.<func> (import-alias aware, syntax-level)

lint-tags.description: fails when a style guide's 'Covered by' linter claims disagree with the nearest golangci config above the guide — a claimed linter must be enabled, a claimed sub-check live; a [lint] headline must carry a coverage bullet; guides with no config above them pass

literal-owner.description: fails when a file outside the allowed path regexp contains the literal

literal-gate.description: fails when a hook package file outside protocol.go holds a package-level literal declaration or a non-trivial numeric literal in a function body — every behavioural value is a catalog row (internal/components)

forbid-addr-lit.description: fails on address-of composite literal (&T{...}) — the pre-Go-1.26 idiom new(expr) replaces

errorf-prefix.description: fails when a fmt.Errorf/errors.New message literal lacks the Component.Method: prefix (RULE-GOLANG-ERR-001)

test-schema.description: fails when t.Run names a case with anything but the house schema's test._id (RULE-GOLANG-TEST-001..005)

gofmt.description: fails when an anchored file is not gofmt-formatted (wraps gofmt -l; exit-0-with-findings normalized to the contract)

func-signature.description: fails when a FuncDecl violates RULE-GOLANG-FUNC-001: ctx first (named ctx), error last, at most 3 return values

comment-cap.description: Comment blocks in the listed Go files run at most max lines

exhaustive-switch.description: fails when a switch over a typed-constant enum misses members (ACTION-IMPL-INTEG-005); go tool exhaustive over the anchored packages

file-baseline.description: fails when an anchored file is absent from the committed baseline list — freezes a file class so no new files of it can be added

symbol-exists.description: task contract: named symbol exists in the anchored files, optionally with the planned signature

symbol-coverage.description: task contract: named function's coverage in the anchored package is at least min percent

golden-diff.description: observation anchor: GET url, normalize, materialize observed=, line-diff against the anchored golden

skill-meta.description: skill metadata checks by mode= param: version-sync (the model file (`<leaf>.cue`) loads — skillgraph.Check owns frontmatter version == changelog[0].version), runtime-meta (the model file (`<leaf>.cue`) loads — skillgraph.Check owns the runtime placement rules), frontmatter (required single-line keys + description shape), allowed-tools (permission-rule dialect) — every mode but version-sync, runtime-meta and routing reads the SKILL.md text, rendered in memory from the model file (`<leaf>.cue`) (a SKILL.md fixture is read as is)

skill-context.description: validates the SKILL.md frontmatter acdsl-context: declaration, the SKILL.md text rendered in memory from the model file (`<leaf>.cue`) (a SKILL.md fixture is read as is) — token grammar (entry ID or trailing-* glob), exact IDs exist in the index= file, globs match at least one entry

skill-map.description: validates context-map.json lane maps — schema (schemaVersion, skill == dir name), lane token grammar and resolvability against the index= file, and each lane's entry set a subset of the skill's acdsl-context declaration, read from the SKILL.md text rendered in memory from the sibling model file (`<leaf>.cue`) (a sibling SKILL.md fixture where no model exists)

severity-table.description: validates a skill's severity-fixtures.json against its sibling schemas/severity-table.json — axes enumerated, every vector combination resolves to exactly one row, every fixture resolves to its expected severity, ids unique

skill-entries.description: the skill model (the model file `<leaf>.cue`) loads (schema, skillgraph.Check — a format-3 skill's fields, links, titles and sources included), entry ids name the leaf dir, gate/hook/schema pointer bullets of a format-2 skill resolvable (the script channel is model-checked on format 3 only), inline enumerations ≤ 6 items

skill-plan-template.description: validates a skill model's plan-template: declaration — the named [payload] entry exists, its template (payloads/<entry-id>.md) opens with ## TLDR, catalog sections (rules/plan.md RULE-PLAN-002) keep catalog order, non-catalog sections carry an <override: placeholder; skills without the key pass

bash32-compat.description: fails when a shell script uses a bash-4+ construct — hooks/routines run under macOS bash 3.2 (launchd)

shellcheck.description: fails on shellcheck findings over the anchored scripts (brew dep, accepted Band D); missing binary is a tool error, never a silent pass

jsonschema.description: fails when an anchored JSON file does not conform to the schema named by schema= — the draft its $schema declares, 2020-12 when absent (santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6)

rules-check.description: wraps cmd/rules by mode= param: validate (ACTION/FACT contract); replaces the raw Makefile audit line

evalgen-bounds.description: fails when a verifier main.go leaves the acdsl/evalgen.json bounds — line count, or an import outside stdlib/internal/go.mod requires (generation may never add a dependency)

id-grammar.description: fails when a doctrine declaration id leaves the KIND-SCOPE[-TOPIC]-NNN grammar or uses an unregistered taxonomy scope/topic; task-lifetime entries exempt

plan-format.description: lintable subset of style/plan.md over design plans: TLDR first, Changelog present, canonical section order

runbook-format.description: fails when a Bruno runbook request file lacks a non-empty docs block or an assert block (rules/runbooks.md lintable subset)

interpretation-format.description: fails when an eval run's interpretation.md holds a heading, a paragraph, more bullets than the cap or a bullet over the rune cap (rules/skills.md RULE-SKILL-020, bounds in internal/evals)

forbid-phrase.description: fails when any anchored file matches the forbidden `pattern` regex, or when `require` is set and no anchored file contains it (content-level)

model-token.description: Every committed model token resolves against the repo templates' availableModels, and subagent-selecting ones may run a subagent (internal/models)

skill-model.description: formal clauses parse; every atom source is arg, session, environment or runtime bound to an enforce capture; atoms resolve and kinds are enforced when the skill sets tier: "strict"
